2024_general.fact: Montgomery is not on Clarity; results are county PDFs. The archive page https://elections.mctx.org/ElectionResults.asp links only post-election files: 2024_November_Precinct_Report.pdf (printed 'Official Results', Run Time 8:44 AM, Run Date 11/18/2024; Last-Modified Tue, 18 Mar 2025 21:02:58 GMT) and 2024_November_Cumulative_Report.pdf (Last-Modified Tue, 18 Mar 2025 21:04:14 GMT). No election-night file found. Wayback and targeted archive lookups for elections.mctx.org returned robots_disallowed_or_unreachable (no captures). One web search found no election-night link.

2026_primary.fact: Election-night county-totals file: https://elections.mctx.org/pdf/PRI030326/Republican%20Cumulative%20Results-3-4-2026%2002-08-24%20AM.pdf, linked from Community Impact article 'keough-wins-montgomery-county-judge-race...' (datePublished 2026-03-04T02:24:40Z; link inside the 'Updated 6:32 a.m.' paragraph). File printed 'Cumulative Results Report ... Unofficial Results ... Precincts Reporting 121 of 121 = 100.00% ... Run Time 2:08 AM Run Date 03/04/2026'; PDF CreationDate Wed Mar 4 08:08:40 2026 UTC; server Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 08:15:33 GMT = 2:15 AM CST, inside the election-night window. The 25-page file has county totals by Early Voting / Absentee / Election Day columns only, no per-precinct rows. The only precinct report found, results/2026_March_Republican_Precinct_Report.pdf, prints 'Official Results', Run Time 3:03 PM, Run Date 03/10/2026, Last-Modified Fri, 27 Mar 2026 22:01:15 GMT. No election-night precinct file was found; the county's live results page https://elections.mctx.org/electioninfo/eResultsMain.aspx was unreachable (proxy 502) and has no archive captures, so its election-night content could not be checked. Precinct numbers appeared after election night (canvass report).

2026_runoff.fact: Only post-election files on the archive page: 2026_May_Republican_Primary_Runoff_Precinct_Report.pdf ('Official Results', Run Time 11:23 AM, Run Date 06/02/2026; Last-Modified Fri, 26 Jun 2026 13:57:04 GMT) and the Cumulative Report (Run 06/02/2026 11:23 AM; Last-Modified Fri, 26 Jun 2026 13:58:45 GMT).
